_schema.note: All 100 EVAL_SUITE.md tasks (Part A TP-01..TP-20 tool probes + Part B F01..F80 framework tasks). Same schema as sessions.json/EVAL_SUITE4.json. Most tasks are standalone single turns (new_thread=true); a few are deliberate two-turn pairs (F60/F62, F64/F65, F67/F68) or a three-part resumability probe (F66) mirroring S14 in sessions.json, where the middle step is type:'action' (a manual Slicer-restart note the harness prints and skips). Approval-mode-specific probes (F30/F31, F70/F71) are scored against whatever approval mode the panel is connected with (see run_all.ps1 -Approval) -- the note field flags which mode the original design intended. Run: run_suite1()  or  run_eval(only=['TP-*'], tasks_file='suite1.json').
